macro.regime: July ends at record highs on a two-day AI-capex relief rally; but a one-year-high 10Y and September-hike odds that ROSE to ~60-65% after hot PCE cap the risk-on
macro.narrative: Re-verified Sun 2 Aug 07:00 SGT (day 2 of the weekend, markets shut) against the Fri 31 Jul US close (levels as of that close). July ended risk-on: a two-day RELIEF RALLY reversed Wednesday's hawkish-hold selloff, taking the S&P 500 to a record 7,489.72 (+0.70% Fri, after +1.7% Thu), the Nasdaq to 25,373.85 (+1.0%) and the Dow to 52,485.03 (+0.53%, a fourth straight winning month) — all three posted weekly gains. The engine was AI-capex re-validation: Amazon surged ~15% on AWS +37% to $42.2bn (its fastest in 18 quarters) with 2026 capex raised to ~$220bn, and the four megacap hyperscalers now guide to a combined $720-745bn of 2026 spend, reversing the AI-overcapacity narrative that had wiped >$1trn from semis; Apple fell ~7% on soft Services/China (idiosyncratic). But the bond market went the other way: sticky June core PCE (+3.3% y/y, headline +3.7%) plus stronger personal spending, against sub-trend Q2 GDP (+1.5%), kept the Fed hawkish — the 10Y rose to ~4.73%, its highest in over a year, and after the hot PCE September-hike odds REPRICED HIGHER to ~60-65% (CME FedWatch ~63%+, prediction markets ~53%) from ~53-61% a week earlier. VIX collapsed to 15.99 as equity fear drained even as rate risk built. The hot PCE also lifted the USD to a 3-week high and knocked the metals off their highs into the weekend: gold slipped ~1.5% to ~$4,045 and silver ~2.2% to ~$57.8 (both still near record/multi-year ground, thesis intact); crypto stayed soft (BTC ~$63k, ETH ~$1,865, crypto Fear&Greed 27). The US-Iran pause stayed broken — a Qatari-LNG tanker (Gaslog Shanghai) was struck transiting Hormuz on 1 Aug (Brent ~$90, WTI ~$85), sustaining the war/inflation premium even as a 10-day ceasefire is floated (Iran denies agreeing). Net: a genuine rebound with AI-capex fears eased and earnings delivering, but a hotter Fed path, a one-year-high 10Y, the oil shock, a record-high tape and stretched positioning cap how far risk-on runs — hence the notch to 53. The delayed week-to-29-Jul Flow Show, Fri's July jobs report (7 Aug) and SGX/HK earnings (DBS 6 Aug, Tencent 12 Aug) are the near-term tells.

After the hot print, September-hike odds REPRICED HIGHER to ~60-65% (CME FedWatch ~63%+, prediction markets ~53%) from ~53-61% — the direct higher-for-longer headwind for levered silver and SGX REITs even as equities rallied to records, and it knocked the metals off their highs on a firmer USD.

Q2 advance GDP slowed to +1.5% (from +2.1%), below expectations — softening growth alongside sticky 3.3% core inflation is the classic stagflation-lite mix. The market looked through it on the earnings/relief rally, but a decelerating economy fattens the left tail for the most cyclical, rate-sensitive parts of the book.

It sustains the war/inflation premium that pressures the rate-sensitive book while restoring the geopolitical bid under gold/silver and lifting the small energy long — the key two-sided cross-portfolio swing factor.

The 12m case rests on the silver structural deficit and gold central-bank/ETF buying; near-term the war premium and 3.3% core PCE are tailwinds, though a hotter Fed path/firmer USD and a durable de-escalation are the offsets.

Lagged the equity records into month-end and stayed soft over the weekend — BTC ~$63k (below its 20-day MA), ETH eased to ~$1,865, SOL ~$73, crypto Fear&Greed 27 ('Fear'); spot-BTC ETFs saw weekly outflows while ETH ETFs drew inflows. Its failure to break higher despite record equities flags the rate backdrop capping risk, and the hotter September repricing is the fresh headwind. Keep sizing small, favor BTC over alts; convexity improves on a dovish Fed pivot.

The 10Y rose to 4.73% — a one-year high — and the 2Y sits at 2026 highs as sticky 3.3% core PCE validated the hawkish Fed; duration got no bid even on sub-trend GDP or the record equity rally. Carry is attractive but a hike-biased Fed and the oil-spike inflation shock cap duration upside near-term. Favor the belly/quality IG over the long end and low-quality HY (OAS ~275bp, thin cushion); a genuine growth scare would reward duration.

Held modest OW: cash yields ~3.5-3.75% at the fed-funds floor give positive carry and a one-year-high 10Y underpins the dollar — the big cash pile stays productive dry powder in a higher-for-longer regime with a record-high tape and a live ~60-65%-odds September hike.
